notes.title: Psebay v.6 — the most significant update yet
notes.notes:
[p][/p][h3]Version 6.0 brings a major overhaul to Psebay. This is more than just an update — it's a complete reimagining of the game.[/h3][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][/h3][h3]What’s changed[/h3][list][*][p][b]Every level. Reimagined.[/b]
Classic stages have been rebalanced and rebuilt from scratch. New levels expand the journey, with improved flow, challenge, and atmosphere.[/p][/*][*][p][b]A new visual identity.[/b]
Graphics, lighting, and effects have all been upgraded to deliver a sharper, more immersive world. The mood is deeper. The landscapes — more expressive.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sound. Reinvented.[/b]
All music and sound design have been replaced with entirely new compositions and effects, carefully crafted to match the tone and rhythm of the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]An interface that gets out of the way.[/b]
The main menu and overall UI have been redesigned to be cleaner, faster, and more focused. Everything you need, nothing you don’t.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The editor, evolved.[/b]
The level editor has been completely overhauled — with new tools, brush types, visual layers, and intuitive controls. Building levels is now smoother, more powerful, and more creative than ever.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]A full breakdown of changes from v.5 and v.6 is available here:[/p][p][url="https://btnchs.space/psebay-updates"]https://btnchs.space/psebay-updates[/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]A few things to note[/h3][list][*][p][b]Steam Workshop is temporarily unavailable[/b] in this release. It will return later as a fully integrated in-game section.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Version 4 remains available[/b] in the Steam [b]beta branch v.4[/b]. If you prefer the classic experience, you can switch to it at any time via the game’s properties.[/p][/*][*][p]For updates and behind-the-scenes development, follow the new official X account: [url="https://x.com/btnchsx"]https://x.com/btnchsx[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Psebay v.6 is available now.[/b][/p][p][b]Welcome back.[/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update v.4.0.32
notes.notes:
• Two new achievements in the infinite level: "Marathon Man: 500m.", "Super Marathon Man: 1000m."
• Updated algorithm for building the infinite level
• Now, when falling at the infinity level, one checkpoint burns down (50m.)
• Added new leaderboard "Top travelers of Psebay 2.0"
• Added new assets in the level editor
• If you purchased "Premium pack of capes" you get an additional 50 stars to improve the bike
• Better than before. Many improvements and fixes

notes.title: Big Update 4 🥳
notes.notes:
Meet a major update with lots of new features and improvements.

Main of the new:

• The main introduction. Capes for the main character - choose what you like and go!

• New levels in the new chapter "Alternative Ways"

• Looks neater and fresher. 90% of the graphics were redrawn

• Added green type of stars to unlock new levels in the "Alternative Ways"

• Added visual changes depending on the upgrades in the garage

• New tools in the level editor

• New sound design of motorbike engine

• A huge number of improvements, fixed bugs found
